Paste your %1$s bearer token. It is sent once as an Authorization header to:
%2$s

The token is kept only with the address it proves — never logged, never exported.

Sign in below. The portal will redirect back to:
%1$s

When you are through the login, press Fetch — the session cookie the browser just earned is used for one request and then dropped. Nothing is written to disk.
✗ No cookie for %1$s yet — finish the login above first.
Press Start. %1$s will show a code to approve in the browser; once approved, the artifact is read from %2$s (%3$s).
Press Start. %1$s will show a code to approve in the browser; once approved, the address it proves is your identity here — nothing is fetched.
Waiting for approval… (the code expires in %1$d min)

✓ %1$s proved %2$s. That provider grants an identity only — fetch your config with a way that grants it.
